D6a-10 the matching rule, stated before it runs. Cells: the 72 changed form cells of fractal-forms-D6.jsonl, each with its deciding ops as the rule wrote them (a restricts cell: restrict; a specifies cell: its leaning add-step, add-condition or link ops). Treated rooms: the form's defining rooms. Pool: the defining rooms of the other five forms. Holding: a room holds an op on a unit where it has a selected line (role defining) with that op on that unit in the D5 lines files, as the rule counted (the script checks that this gives back the facts files' counts). Matching: each treated room is matched, with replacement, to the 5 pool rooms nearest it on the measure, by absolute difference of the natural log of (measure + 1), ties broken by room name. Two measures, run separately: (1) record size, coded concepts; (2) canvas-work concepts (D01 to D04). Matched share of an op: the mean over treated rooms of the share of their five matches that hold it. Size-held ratio: the form's share over the matched share. An op survives a matching where its size-held ratio is 1.2 or more (the rule's ratio; the holders are the form's own and already meet the floor; a matched share of 0 counts as surviving). A cell survives a matching where at least one of its deciding ops survives. A cell survives the test where it survives both matchings; where it fails either, it is size-dependent, and the file says which. Reported, not used for the mark: the ratio against the other five forms unmatched (to separate the change of baseline from the matching), and the survival at 3 and at 10 matches. New column in form-cells-sensitivity-D6.tsv: size-dependent where the cell fails the test, else its earlier mark (robust or marginal).

None of the 20 cells marked robust at D6a-09 is size-dependent. At 3 and at 10 matches (reported, not used), 7 cells change outcome, all near the 1.2 line: 6 that survive at 5 fail at 3 or 10 (B P08, C P05, C A13, D A02, D A01, E P23), and A P12 survives at both.
